title: leucanthemum bauhini
intro: Leucanthemum bauhini, commonly known as the Pyrethrum or Bachelor's Button, is a flowering plant that belongs to the daisy family Asteraceae. The plant is known for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating inflammation and fever, due to its ability to reduce pain and promote relaxation. The health benefits of Leucanthemum bauhini include its antibacterial and antiviral properties, which can help to combat infections and support the immune system. The bioactive constituents of the plant include pyrethrins, sesquiterpene lactones, and flavonoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and sedative properties.
